_comment: Configuration file for neuroimaging analysis pipeline
_comment_usage: Modify the paths, settings, and enabled stages according to your setup
_comment_datasets: Add your datasets here with their paths and script names

data_directories._comment: Set the root path where all your datasets are stored
data_directories._comment_dataset_root: This is the base directory containing all your dataset folders
data_directories._comment: Relative paths to pipeline directories (usually don't need to change)

datasets._comment: Add your datasets here. Each dataset needs:
datasets._comment_dataset_structure: 1. 'path': where the dataset is located (use ${dataset_root} variable)
2. 'bids_script': MATLAB script to convert to BIDS format
4. 'enabled': set to true to include this dataset in analysis
datasets._comment_add_more_datasets: To add more datasets, copy the structure above and modify:

output_directories._comment: Set where to save results and figures
output_directories._comment_paths: Use absolute paths for best compatibility

execution_mode._comment_local: Use 'local' for running on your own machine
execution_mode._comment_slurm: Use 'slurm' for running on a cluster with SLURM scheduler
execution_mode._comment_slurm_settings: SLURM cluster settings (only used if type='slurm')

slurm_settings._comment: Maximum time limit for jobs (format: DD-HH:MM:SS)
SLURM account (leave empty if not needed)
Email notification type: NONE, BEGIN, END, FAIL, ALL

execution_mode._comment_local_settings: Local execution settings (only used if type='local')

local_settings._comment: Maximum number of jobs to run in parallel
Use GNU parallel for better parallelization (requires GNU parallel to be installed)

analysis_settings._comment: Analysis parameters that affect the pipeline
analysis_settings._comment_subjects: Minimum number of subjects required per site

software_paths._comment: Paths to required software (use absolute paths)
software_paths._comment_freesurfer: Path to FreeSurfer installation (leave empty if not using SBM)
software_paths._comment_cat12: Path to CAT12 installation (leave empty if not using VBM)

_comment_quick_start_2: 2. Add your datasets in the 'datasets' section
